en.title: Records of Forgotten Transactions
en.premise: In the year 203X, a black market for memories has emerged in the shadows of the city—a byproduct of neural connection technology that allows for the illegal extraction and sale of personal experiences. Detective Kisaragi of the Metropolitan Police Department's First Investigation Division discovers a corpse with a physically destroyed memory chip embedded in its brain. With the victim's memories fragmented, Kisaragi's investigation leads him into a web of internal cover-ups within the police force and toward a truth hidden at 'Promised Hill,' the ultimate destination for the memory trade.

zh.title: 遗忘的交易记录
zh.premise: 203X年，作为神经连接技术的副产品，一个非法提取并买卖个人经历的“记忆市场”在城市的阴影中悄然形成。警视厅搜查一课的如月刑事发现了一具脑内记忆芯片遭到物理破坏的尸体。由于死者的记忆已支离破碎，随着调查的深入，如月不仅陷入了调查组织内部的掩盖阴谋，更被迫直面隐藏在记忆最终交易地——“约定之丘”背后的真相。
